Liverpool and Manchester United hold one of the biggest rivalries in the history of English football. When they met during the 2022/23 season what played out was one of the most remarkable performances ever seen in Premier League history. Jurgen Klopp's Liverpool put on an outrageous second-half performance to defeat Erik ten Hag's side by the biggest margin in the derby's history.
